Mobile phone prices may decrease as GST and import duties are reviewed

Reports suggest potential reductions in the Goods and Services Tax (GST) on smartphones from 18% to 5%. Additionally, import duties on six mobile phone components have been removed. These changes could lead to more affordable smartphones for consumers in India.
